name: Smart Shuffle
description: Builds a per-user "Smart Shuffle" playlist from the series in a collection. Shows are interleaved randomly, episodes within a show stay in order, and progress is tracked by the plugin so the shows keep their watched state and stay out of Next Up and Continue Watching.
overview: Shuffle a set of TV shows while keeping each show's episodes in order

versions.changelog:
- Supports Jellyfin 12.1 (targetAbi 12.1.0.0)
- Records play count and last played date before playback, since Jellyfin 12.1 overwrites the last played date when playback starts

Initial release.

- Per-user Smart Shuffle playlist from the shows in a collection
- Episodes stay in order within each show
- Shows stay watched and out of Next Up / Continue Watching
- Resume partly watched episodes via remote seek
